messages:
Alex: Morning async — sprint snapshot for SampleKit. TL;DR: shipping v0.3 quickstarts, docs fixes, and one blocker on CI.
Riley: Done: bumped SampleKit Node SDK to 1.2. Added README examples. PR #412 ready for review.
Sam: Blocker: CI flakes on macOS wheels — failing in integration test: `npm run test:integration` times out on deasync step. Repro locally on M1.
Maria: I'll pair on that later today. Also opened docs PR to fix parameter names in quickstart (PR #413).
Taylor: Today: will review #412 and #413, and finish sample app Dockerfile optimizations. ETA EOD.
Alex: Notes: for #412 please run `yarn build && yarn lint` before requesting review. Also, consider switching to `node:18-bullseye` base image.
Riley: Ping @Sam — can you post the failing log snippet? pastebin helpful.
Sam: log:
```
Error: Timeout waiting for native module load
    at Object.<anonymous> (.../node_modules/deasync/index.js:47:15)
    at Module._compile (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:999:30)
```
Link: https://pastebin.com/abcd1234
Maria: Resolved a docs markdown-lint issue by adding frontmatter. Also adding cross-link to API reference.
Taylor: :thumbsup: If CI still flakes, let's add a flaky-test label and isolate it.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: SampleKit demo deployed to staging at https://staging.samplekit.redwood.ai — build 2026-03-15-18
Alex: Decision: freeze changes to sample app until #412 merges. If you need to push urgent fixes, open a PR to `hotfix/samplekit`.
Riley: Question: do we want a separate quickstart for Dedicated users? That would cover reserved capacity hints.
Maria: Yes, suggest a short "Dedicated quickstart" section under quickstarts page. I can draft.
Sam: Going to try a Docker-based reproducible CI run today and report back.
Taylor: Reminder: weekly demo on Friday — SampleKit needs screenshots and a demo script. Can someone volunteer for script? @Riley?
Riley: I can take the demo script. Will add to the repo under docs/demo.md.
Alex: Thanks — wrap-up: blockers tracked in #412 CI issue, keep PR link in thread. If blocked >4 hours, escalate in #eng-help. :rocket:
